name: Jamaican Banana Fritters
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical banana fritter recipes using 3 bananas and 1 cup flour, producing about 8-12 small fritters for 4 servings
Preparation time estimated from instructions: mashing/mixing ~5 min, frying in batches ~10-15 min, total ~20 min
Oil type unspecified so Soy classified null
No dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, or sesame listed
Salt, spices, vanilla, sugar, bananas, and oil are plant-based and compatible with listed diets
'For frying' oil conservatively classified as absorbed amount only; no brand-specific allergens assumed
instructions:
Mash bananas with fork in bowl.
Add brown sugar, vanilla, extract, cinnamon, nutmeg and a pinch of salt. Sift in flour and stir with spoon until fully combined.
Add oil to a 10 inch skillet over medium-high heat. Once oil is hot, drop banana fritter batter in oil by the spoonful. Once one side is golden and bubbles appear on the top, flip fritter and cook until the other side is browned as well.
Remove fritters and drain on paper towels. Enjoy

ingredients.name: Banana
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium bananas ≈ 300g edible peeled weight; standard raw banana values

ingredients.name: Vanilla Extract
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp vanilla extract ≈ 5g; typical values for pure vanilla extract

ingredients.name: Cinnamon
ingredients.assumptions: ½ tsp ground cinnamon ≈ 1g; standard ground cinnamon values

ingredients.name: Nutmeg
ingredients.assumptions: ¼ tsp ground nutmeg ≈ 0.5g; standard ground nutmeg values

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons packed brown sugar ≈ 38g; standard brown sugar values

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of salt ≈ 0.3g; negligible macros, treated as 0

ingredients.name: All purpose flour
ingredients.assumptions: 1 cup all-purpose flour ≈ 125g; standard AP flour values

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Oil for frying (10-inch skillet, shallow fry) estimated at 25g absorbed/retained across batch; typical neutral frying oil values
